description: Connect your Visitta account to find doctors and itineraries, create an empty or populated itinerary, edit its doctor list with optional appointments and manual or distance ordering, request automatic filling or time suggestions within the same itinerary, choose whether completed visits count toward cycle coverage, and record or correct visits. Every new itinerary has a date, defaulting to today in Visitta's time zone, with optional times and cycle credit in the same flow. Itinerary and doctor changes require a reviewed preview and confirmation. Requested appointments remain separate from estimates; conflicts can be saved as drafts after explicit acceptance. Access is limited to the authorized account. The plugin does not delete doctors or itineraries, search the public web, or manage meeting calendars.

defaultPrompt: Crie um roteiro para hoje sem contabilizar no ciclo.
Qual é meu roteiro de hoje?

positive.description: Read a saved demonstration itinerary. Setup: a dedicated account with one itinerary named DEMO-MCP — gravação dated 2026-09-29. List saved itineraries with from_date=2026-09-29 and to_date=2026-09-29 before reading its details, containing DEMO-MCP Dra. Ana completed, DEMO-MCP Dr. Bruno and DEMO-MCP Dra. Carla pending. Resolve its actual ID from the account; no invented IDs.
positive.prompt: Mostre apenas o roteiro DEMO-MCP — gravação de 29/09/2026. Resuma os médicos e quem está concluído ou pendente.
positive.expected_behavior: Show only the named itinerary and its three doctors using returned data. Ana is completed, Bruno and Carla pending. Read calls do not create cycles or change account records.

positive.description: Create an intentionally incomplete fictional doctor. Setup: CRM 9990004 AL is absent; Cardiologia is enabled. The reviewer explicitly confirms after inspecting the preview.
positive.prompt: Cadastre a médica fictícia DEMO-MCP Dra. Helena, CRM 9990004 AL, cardiologista, em Maceió/AL. Ainda não tenho o endereço. Deixe o cadastro pendente, sem inventar informações.
positive.expected_behavior: Preview the provided name, CRM, specialty and city; explain the missing address. Save only after confirmation with the matching preview token. Return one created doctor pending route details, without invented address, coordinates or a claim of readiness for routes.

positive.description: Update only one weekday. Setup: one DEMO-MCP Dra. Ana with attendance 08:00–17:00 on weekdays and no Tuesday visit window. Reviewer confirms the preview.
positive.prompt: Para DEMO-MCP Dra. Ana, altere somente terça-feira: atendimento das 8h às 12h e visita de representante das 9h às 9h30. Mostre antes e depois.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify the exact fictional doctor. Preview Tuesday attendance 08:00–12:00 and visit 09:00–09:30, then save only after confirmation using matching changes and preview token. Other weekdays and existing itinerary visits remain unchanged.

positive.description: Complete a pending visit already present in the demonstration itinerary. Setup: DEMO-MCP Dr. Bruno has a pending visit in that itinerary and belongs to the active cycle. Resolve IDs from the actual response; reviewer confirms the doctor and target. The itinerary date is 2026-09-29; find that saved date if testing later.
positive.prompt: Conclua a visita de DEMO-MCP Dr. Bruno no roteiro DEMO-MCP — gravação de 29/09/2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify the pending Bruno visit, ask for confirmation and complete only that visit. Return a non-null completed_at; cycle coverage records the completion without recalculating the route or changing Carla.

positive.description: Correct a mistaken completion. Setup: DEMO-MCP Dra. Ana has a completed visit in the same demonstration itinerary. Reviewer confirms reopening. The itinerary date is 2026-09-29; find that saved date if testing later.
positive.prompt: No roteiro DEMO-MCP — gravação de 29/09/2026, a conclusão de DEMO-MCP Dra. Ana foi marcada por engano. Desfaça somente essa conclusão.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify Ana in the named itinerary, ask for confirmation and reopen only her visit. Return completed_at=null. Remove her visit completion from cycle coverage while preserving the doctor, itinerary, visit and other doctors.

positive.description: Create an itinerary without cycle credit or times using the unified flow. Setup: two active located fictional doctors DEMO-MCP Dra. Ana and DEMO-MCP Dr. Bruno, plus a located saved point DEMO-MCP Base. Resolve all identifiers from queries. The reviewer explicitly confirms each preview.
positive.prompt: Crie um roteiro rápido fora de ciclo com DEMO-MCP Dra. Ana e DEMO-MCP Dr. Bruno, saindo do ponto salvo DEMO-MCP Base. Mostre a ordem e a distância antes de salvar.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the doctors and chosen saved point in the authorized account. Use preview_itinerary with today's date by default, counts_toward_cycle=false, optional times left blank and the requested distance order. Save only after confirmation with create_itinerary and the matching payload/token. Return the actual date and saved itinerary link; do not create a separate route type. Repeated confirmation must not duplicate it.

negative.description: Do not trigger for unrelated calendar requests. The app should not be invoked because meeting calendars are outside its supported workflows. Do not invoke any Visitta tool.
Permanent doctor deletion is unsupported. Explain the limitation without invoking any Visitta tool or replacing deletion with deactivation or cycle removal.
negative.prompt: O Visitta consegue apagar definitivamente DEMO-MCP Dra. Carla?

negative.description: Do not trigger for open-ended web searches. The app should not be invoked because it only works with the authenticated user's Visitta records. Do not invoke any Visitta tool.
negative.prompt: Pesquise na internet os melhores médicos do Brasil.

negative.description: Never invent the requested current location. Ask for actual coordinates or a saved point before previewing a departure from the current location; a basic doctor list otherwise needs no departure.
negative.prompt: Crie um roteiro saindo de onde estou agora, mas não vou informar minha localização nem escolher um ponto salvo.

negative.description: Permanent itinerary deletion and its visits is unsupported by the plugin. Explain the limitation without modifying records or suggesting another itinerary type.
negative.prompt: O plugin pode apagar definitivamente um roteiro e todas as suas visitas?

publication.release_notes: Use one itinerary workflow with a default date, optional appointments and cycle credit. Retire separate simple-itinerary tools from discovery and align help and examples.

pt-BR.subtitle: Médicos, roteiros e visitas
pt-BR.description: Conecte sua conta Visitta para consultar médicos e roteiros, criar e editar a lista de médicos com ordem manual ou por distância e compromissos opcionais, escolher se as visitas concluídas contam no ciclo e registrar ou corrigir visitas. Todo roteiro novo tem data, por padrão hoje no fuso do Visitta; horários e contabilização no ciclo são opcionais no mesmo fluxo. Alterações de roteiros e médicos exigem prévia e confirmação. Compromissos informados ficam separados das estimativas; conflitos podem ser salvos como rascunho após aceitação explícita. O acesso se limita à conta autorizada. O plugin não exclui médicos nem roteiros, pesquisa a internet ou gerencia reuniões.
